description.value: Dave's Fish & Chips is a Richmond institution on Moncton Street in the Steveston area, serving classic golden fish and chips since 1978. The restaurant features a dine-in space with a licensed bar alongside convenient takeout, making it a natural fuel stop for cyclists exploring Steveston's waterfront paths. Its decades-long reputation for fresh ingredients and consistent flavour has made it a fixture for both locals and visitors.
